dashboard.tour-bienvenida-descripcion: You're about to discover everything you can do here. This tour only takes a couple of minutes and will help you prepare better for your exam.
dashboard.tour-practicas-descripcion: Here you'll find everything about your practice sessions. You can practice by subject, review your history and resume unfinished sessions.
dashboard.tour-practicas-nueva-descripcion: Start a new practice session from here. You can choose the process and the subjects you want to review.
dashboard.tour-practicas-historial-descripcion: This page shows all your previous sessions: which ones you completed, your score and the ones still pending. You can also start a new one right from here.
dashboard.tour-practicas-iniciar-descripcion: This button takes you straight to the form to create a new practice, without going through the side menu.
dashboard.tour-practica-proceso-descripcion: First choose the process your practice belongs to. The subjects available to you are loaded automatically based on the process.
dashboard.tour-practica-comenzar-descripcion: Once you've selected the process and at least one subject, this button becomes active. Click it to start answering questions. When you finish you'll see your correct and incorrect answers.
dashboard.tour-simulacros-descripcion: Mock exams are full timed exams, just like the real conditions of your evaluation. When you finish you get your grade on a 100-point scale.
dashboard.tour-simulacros-historial-descripcion: Here you see all your exams: your grade on each one, whether you passed, and the date. Over time you'll be able to track your progress and improve your performance.
dashboard.tour-simulacros-nuevo-descripcion: Create a new exam from here. The mock exam reproduces the real conditions: limited time and no checking answers until you finish.
dashboard.tour-simulacro-proceso-descripcion: Select the process you want to take the mock exam for. All subjects and the official exam configuration will be loaded automatically.
dashboard.tour-simulacro-iniciar-descripcion: This button starts the timer. You'll have the exact time of the real exam to answer all the questions. When you finish you'll see your grade, whether you passed, and an analysis of your answers.
dashboard.tour-perfil-descripcion: Here you'll find a summary of your performance: how many mock exams you took, your average grade, your best grade and your practice progress. You can also replay this tour whenever you want.
